name: antigravity-remote-plus
description: Remote control for Antigravity IDE: web UI + Telegram. Chat history, new chat, realtime messaging, send files/images, revert, model picker, quota, file & GitHub control.

commands.title: Relaunch IDE with Remote Debugging (sync web ⇄ IDE)

antigravityRemotePlus.autoStart.description: Automatically start the remote server when the IDE opens

antigravityRemotePlus.port.description: Local HTTP port for the web UI + API server

antigravityRemotePlus.bindHost.description: Network interface to bind the server to

antigravityRemotePlus.password.description: Password required to access the web UI and API

antigravityRemotePlus.telegramChatId.description: Allowed Telegram chat ID (only this chat can control the IDE)

antigravityRemotePlus.telegramNotifyOnCo.description: Gửi thông báo qua Telegram khi Agent hoàn thành câu trả lời hoặc kết thúc tác vụ

antigravityRemotePlus.remoteDebugPort.description: Remote debugging (CDP) port used to sync the IDE chat panel with the web UI. The IDE must be launched with --remote-debugging-port set to this value; use the 'Relaunch IDE with Remote Debugging' command.

antigravityRemotePlus.workspaceRoot.description: Folder that contains your project folders (e.g. /Users/you/Documents). The web UI lists its subfolders as quick 'open workspace' choices.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && cd web && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:ext
scripts.package: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && npx @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies -o antigravity-remote-plus.vsix && node scripts/install-and-reload.js
